periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree angle oriented towards the snout relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-elongated, with the vertical dimension significantly exceeding the horizontal dimension.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Noticeable downward tapering with the inferior portion narrower than the superior portion.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 30-35% of the visible lateral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap, roughly 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular contour at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown tinting present on the ventral and thoracic fur.
